scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/contract && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run db:generate -w apps/api && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run build -w apps/api --ignore-scripts && npm run build -w apps/web --ignore-scripts
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/contract && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run db:generate -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/e2e
scripts.precheck:arch: npm run build -w packages/contract && npm run db:generate -w apps/api
scripts.check:arch: depcruise packages/contract/src packages/contract/tests apps/api/src apps/api/tests apps/api/prisma apps/api/prisma.config.ts apps/api/vitest.config.ts apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/vitest.config.ts apps/e2e --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
